PullRequest.Title: Agents window: use spacing tokens in multi-file diff cards
PullRequest.Body:
This completes the remaining off-ramp horizontal spacing cleanup in the shared multi-diff file-card stylesheet that now owns the Agents window presentation.

### Changes

- replace both remaining raw `5px` horizontal spacing values with `--vscode-spacing-size60`
- preserve line-height, type-size, control-size, and shadow geometry literals that do not have semantically matching design tokens
- retain the existing compact Agents window layout across expanded and collapsed file-card states

### Validation

- `npm run stylelint -- src/vs/editor/browser/widget/multiDiffEditor/style.css`
- repository pre-commit hygiene hook
- `git diff --check`
- separately built the base revision (`f3f750b79fa`) and fixed revision (`23e8647cea5`), then rendered the same 520×620 Agents window compact multi-file diff fixture in expanded and collapsed states for Dark, Light, High Contrast Dark, and High Contrast Light
- Component Explorer comparison: 8 before/after fixture pairs, no differences

Fixes #327715

### Token mappings

| Selector/property | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| `.multiDiffEditor-standard .collapse-button` margin | `margin: 0 5px` | `margin: 0 var(--vscode-spacing-size60)` |
| `.multiDiffEditor-standard .header-content` padding | `padding: var(--vscode-spacing-size40) 5px` | `padding: var(--vscode-spacing-size40) var(--vscode-spacing-size60)` |

`--vscode-spacing-size60` resolves to 6px. Type, line-height, control-size, and shadow literals without a semantic token remain unchanged.

These screenshots use the same 520x620 Agents window compact multi-file diff fixture and state. **Before** was rendered from base commit `f3f750b79fa`; **After** was rendered from fixed commit `23e8647cea5`. Component Explorer reported all eight pairs as byte-identical.

Scenarios.Scenario: Render, scroll, resize, and expand/collapse standard multi-file diff cards in the Agents window
Scenarios.CriticalPath: Browser style resolution and layout must complete before the changed card headers and collapse controls paint. The diff only replaces two static 5px CSS lengths with the theme size token, which resolves to 6px for all themes; it adds no script-driven geometry read, nested layout, or other work to the critical path.
Scenarios.ScalingInput: Number of visible standard multi-diff entries. Both before and after, the browser applies one margin declaration and one padding declaration per matching entry; the diff does not change selector complexity or operation cardinality.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: Single browser rendering pipeline on the UI thread; the change adds no task, queue, listener, asynchronous operation, or concurrency burst.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: The stylesheet and registered theme size are loaded through existing theme/style infrastructure. Cold and warm behavior are unchanged apart from resolving an already registered custom property; no cache key, invalidation, coalescing, or negative-cache behavior changes.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High confidence that the changed path is limited to static CSS style resolution and ordinary layout; repository definition confirms spacing.size60 is 6px for all themes, and no subprocess, IPC, filesystem, database, network, serialization, or dynamic scheduling boundary is introduced.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Exact style-resolution cost is not measured, but there is no changed scaling mechanism: the same two declarations apply to the same elements, and the token is a fixed 6px value across themes.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable performance regression. The one-pixel spacing adjustment may alter geometry but does not increase selector work, layout frequency, retained state, boundary calls, or asymptotic rendering cost.

Analysis.Summary: Completed the performance pass over the sole changed file and both diff hunks. The substitutions use an existing fixed theme size token in static margin and padding declarations; no actionable performance mechanism or regression was introduced.
